item.title: The Role of Land Power in the Future Global Security Environment
item.description: As conflicts evolve, CSIS is launching a study to examine the future role of U.S. land forces and their mission, structure, and resourcing within the joint force. This study will consider what a strong, adaptable land power presence means for our national security.

item.title: Everything Is Connected Part II
item.description: In this week's column, Bill Reinsch describes how the war in Iran has illustrated the unintended consequences of policy decisions, arguing for government action that anticipates and plans for contingencies.

item.title: Closing the Local Knowledge Gap in U.S. Competition with China
item.description: China is extending its influence at the hyper-local level, but the United States has yet to develop a comprehensive strategy to push back at the edge of strategic competition. The United States must leverage industry tools to provide the data-driven insights needed to compete.

item.title: New Momentum, Old Problems: Transatlantic Export Control Considerations
item.description: The newly introduced MATCH Act seeks to close gaps in U.S. export restrictions by limiting China's access to advanced chipmaking tools through non-U.S. suppliers—but its reach into European supply chains raises serious questions for the transatlantic relationship.

item.title: A Conversation with WTO Director General Dr. Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala | The Futures Summit
item.description: WTO Director General Dr. Ngozi Okonjo-Iweala joined the CSIS Futures Summit to discuss how the WTO can navigate geopolitical shocks and spearhead mindset shifts to ensure inclusivity.

item.title: States Weekly: April 15, 2026
item.description: This edition of States Weekly covers April 15, 2026.

item.title: The Way Forward for Global Health | The Futures Summit
item.description: Experts discussed how the funding environment for global health has shifted internationally, how they are focusing their organizations’ priorities as the world moves more fully into a post-Covid moment, and what innovations they are most excited to deliver in the years ahead.

item.title: The Lenacapavir Partnership and the Evolution of U.S. Foreign Assistance | The Futures Summit
item.description: Experts discussed the partnership between the State Department, Gilead Sciences, and the Global Fund to Fight AIDS, Tuberculosis and Malaria to procure and deliver Lenacapavir—a groundbreaking twice-yearly injectable pre-exposure prophylaxis (PrEP) for HIV prevention.
